benchmark: short ride around one hour or less
starting_reference: No obligatory hourly carbohydrate target for every rider
evidence_to_record: Pre-ride nutrition; intensity; session purpose; daily energy context
confirmed: Task completed as intended with surrounding intake and recovery appropriate
partial: Result is acceptable but pre-ride or recovery context is unknown
not_demonstrated: A zero or high target was copied without defining the task
next_action: Define the session and surrounding nutrition before adding a number

evidence_to_record: Planned and actual carbohydrate; duration; intensity; products; symptoms
confirmed: Range was genuinely executed and tolerated in representative work
partial: Only one test exists or actual intake differed for a recorded reason
not_demonstrated: Target was not counted from actual products
next_action: Reconcile products and repeat a comparable ride

starting_reference: Progress toward up to 90 g carbohydrate per hour when required
evidence_to_record: Multiple carbohydrate sources; concentration; access; actual intake; tolerance; late execution
confirmed: Practised target supports the task in more than one representative session
partial: One test worked or a product, access or symptom issue remains
not_demonstrated: Event target has never been rehearsed
next_action: Change one variable and repeat before event day

starting_reference: Advanced task-specific experiment rather than amateur default
evidence_to_record: Clear performance reason; gradual rehearsal; suitable products; symptoms; qualified input where needed
confirmed: Individual plan is repeatable and evidence is interpreted within its limits
partial: Tolerance or performance benefit remains uncertain
not_demonstrated: Copied from professional practice without preparation
next_action: Return to a lower executable target or involve a sports dietitian

starting_reference: Duration plus intensity, terrain, conditions, prior meal and next-session context
evidence_to_record: One-sentence reason for the intake target
confirmed: Demand and fuelling purpose are explicit
partial: Duration is known but intensity, environment or recovery context is incomplete
not_demonstrated: Target was copied from another rider or advert
next_action: Write why this ride needs this target

starting_reference: Product labels or recipes reconciled with hourly target
evidence_to_record: Every bottle, food item and access point
confirmed: Numbers reconcile and each hour has an executable product plan
partial: Total is known but access, concentration or spare capacity is unclear
not_demonstrated: Headline grams have no product count
next_action: Pack and count the ride before it starts

starting_reference: Total carbohydrate consumed divided by riding time with stops recorded
evidence_to_record: Returned products; dropped bottles; feed changes; timing of shortfall
confirmed: Planned and actual are close enough that the target was tested
partial: Actual drifted but the reason and timing are recorded
not_demonstrated: Consumption is estimated without knowing what remained
next_action: Make the existing plan easier to execute before raising it

starting_reference: Symptoms interpreted with heat, intensity, concentration, illness and pre-ride context
evidence_to_record: Nausea; bloating; reflux; cramps; urgency; vomiting; onset time
confirmed: Target and products tolerated more than once in representative work
partial: One test worked or manageable symptoms remain
not_demonstrated: Event intake has never been rehearsed
next_action: Change one variable and repeat; seek qualified help for persistent or severe symptoms

starting_reference: Repeated comparable rides rather than one late fade
evidence_to_record: Late power or pace; RPE; cadence; cognition; conditions; pacing; recovery
confirmed: Comparable rides show the plan supports the required work
partial: Ride succeeded once or the cause of a problem remains ambiguous
not_demonstrated: Target has not been linked to a comparable outcome
next_action: Repeat without changing training, pacing and nutrition at once

starting_reference: Hourly intake reviewed inside the full training day and week
evidence_to_record: Meals; recovery; next key session; fatigue; health and performance context
confirmed: In-ride plan sits inside adequate daily intake and supports required recovery
partial: Ride target is known but the surrounding day is not reviewed
not_demonstrated: Low intake is used for weight loss or fat adaptation without monitoring consequences
next_action: Audit the whole day and seek appropriate care for RED-S or clinical concerns

starting_reference: Use task-based ranges without automatically lowering intake
evidence_to_record: Energy availability; individual symptoms; cycle context where relevant; performance; recovery
confirmed: Individual plan meets the task without false sex-specific precision
partial: Useful observations exist but clinical or nutrition complexity remains
not_demonstrated: Target is lowered or phase-adjusted from unsupported assumptions
next_action: Secure adequate availability and involve a sports dietitian where appropriate
